anomaly_detection.purpose: Identify anomalies in daily activity totals
anomaly_detection.output: JSON with anomalies, baseline_mean, baseline_stddev, Turkish explanation
anomaly_detection.system_prompt: Act as a statistical watchdog. Follow the Detection Algorithm strictly and reply ONLY with the JSON schema in Output. Explanation must be in Turkish. No additional text.

auto_categorization.purpose: Assign categories to events using heuristics and ML
auto_categorization.input: JSON with events array (app, title, url)
auto_categorization.output: JSON with labels array (index, category, confidence)
auto_categorization.algorithm: TF-IDF on title/url domain, boost by app mapping, softmax confidence, taxonomy: coding, design, research, social, gaming, productivity, communication
auto_categorization.system_prompt: You are a classification engine. Use the Labeling Algorithm and the following fixed taxonomy: `coding`, `design`, `research`, `social`, `gaming`, `productivity`, `communication`. Return ONLY the JSON described in Output.

behavioral_trends.purpose: Detect trends and seasonality in daily totals
behavioral_trends.output: JSON with trending_categories, seasonality, Turkish summary ≤280 chars
behavioral_trends.algorithm: Linear regression slope per category (>+100 rising, <-100 falling), autocorrelation for seasonality, top 5 slopes
behavioral_trends.system_prompt: You are an analytics engine that performs time-series trend detection per the algorithm above and returns ONLY the JSON described in the Output. Write the `summary` in Turkish, concise (≤280 chars).

community_rules.input: JSON with event (app, title, url), community_rules array
community_rules.output: JSON with matched_rule, category, source (or null)
community_rules.algorithm: Iterate rules by popularity, glob/regex match, first match wins
community_rules.system_prompt: You are a rule-matching engine. Apply rules exactly as described; return ONLY the Output JSON. No extra commentary.

contextual_categorization.output: JSON with category, confidence, English rationale ≤140 chars
contextual_categorization.algorithm: Zero-shot classification with labels: coding, design, research, social, news, entertainment, communication, shopping; translate if needed
contextual_categorization.system_prompt: You are a zero-shot classifier. Return ONLY the JSON in Output. Rationale must be ≤140 characters and in English.

focus_quality_score.purpose: Calculate Focus Quality Score from events
focus_quality_score.output: JSON with session_scores array, daily_average, explanations
focus_quality_score.algorithm: Base 100, -1 per switch after first, -0.5/min low input, -10 social, +5/-5 time bonuses, clamp 0-100
focus_quality_score.system_prompt: You are a strict analytics engine that calculates Focus Quality Scores exactly as specified above. Respond ONLY with valid JSON that conforms to the Output schema. Do NOT include any other text. If input contains no qualifying sessions, return `null` for `session_scores` and `daily_average`.

templates.ai_service_layer: cloud-functions/src/ai/ai-service.ts template with onCall for classifyActivity and generatePersonalizedInsights
